translation: My accumulation of more than sixty years can also be said to be much; exhausting several months of work, I already obtained great effect, and after more than a year, it was washed clean in one go. Can this not be called spirit-like and swift? I do not know whether I alone am like this, or whether everyone can be like this. In the vast heaven and earth, there is no one before and no one after; from whom can I seek correction? At its completion, I wrote this one book and gave it to my sons and nephews, leaving it for consultation; is there also one like me? I beg their appraisal. If there are those of like mind who cultivate themselves, imitating it to preserve their bodies, they can also correct my shortcomings.
